name: Mystery Trip
description:
About This Game

The game is a classic HOG (Hidden Object Game), created especially for those who appreciate attention to detail and thoughtful gameplay. You will encounter a large number of hidden object scenes, each unique and filled with subtle clues.

In addition to searching, the gameplay is enriched with engaging mini-games of varying difficulty: from picking ingenious locks to conducting chemical experiments in the professor’s laboratory. Each puzzle is logically woven into the storyline, turning your investigation into a dynamic and captivating adventure.
short_desc: A wealthy merchant brought his daughter some amazing tiny creatures. Charming, they quickly became her best friends, but a sudden storm carried them away into the unknown. Now it is up to you to accept the challenge and bring the pets back! You can look forward to 5–6 hours of engaging gameplay.
